from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class OperatingCashFlowPeriod(BaseModel):
    """Cash flow amount for a single reporting period."""
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The net cash flow amount as reported")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The unit scale of the amount: 'dollars', 'thousands', 'millions', etc.")
    period_end_date: str | None = Field(description="The end date of this reporting period")

class CompanyOperatingCashFlow(BaseModel):
    """Operating cash flow data extracted from one company's 10-Q filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the filing")
    current_period: OperatingCashFlowPeriod | None = Field(description="Current period (most recent) operating cash flow")
    prior_period: OperatingCashFlowPeriod | None = Field(description="Prior period (comparative) operating cash flow")
    cash_flow_label: str | None = Field(description="The line item label as written, e.g., 'Net cash from operating activities'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt anchoring the figures")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_operating_cash_flows: list[CompanyOperatingCashFlow]
